title: Act III, Scene III

teacherSummary.text: Claudius orders Hamlet sent to England. Alone, he confesses his crime but cannot truly repent. Hamlet finds him kneeling and refuses to kill him while praying, for fear of sending him to heaven. Claudius rises: his words were empty.
